mother of Maria (Trench) Wilson

She was a sister of the 6th Earl of Egmont and of Sir William Heathcote's first wife; she married (9 Jan 1816) the Rev.

Frederick Stuart Trench (19 March 1787-23 Nov 1860).

She lived with her daughter Mrs Wilson at Rownhams by 1867.

She was aunt by marriage to Frances Dorothy (Grimston) Moor; another of her daughters Helena Trench (1820-1908) married the Very Rev.

Jeffrey Lefroy, Dean of Dromore, and was the mother of George Alfred Lefroy, Bishop of Calcutta (1854–1919) [PB 1914 Ashtown;  PO Hants 1867; Erminois; ODNB]
